systems.name: creative-apps
systems.description: The macOS app shells of the creative suite: five SwiftUI apps (Flare, Design, Photo, Library, Halo), each over a Linux-safe Model target, plus the SuiteUI design system.

containers.name: SuiteUI
containers.description: The shared design system (Sources/SuiteUI): tokens, Liquid Glass primitives, the SuiteWindow shell, toolbar palette, sidebar rows and sections, content-layer surfaces, pro inspector rows and scrub fields, a thumbnail grid and a timeline strip. macOS only; knows no Model or engine.

components.name: SuiteUI sources
components.description: The shared design system (Sources/SuiteUI): spacing, radius, size, type and color tokens; Liquid Glass applied in one snapshot-aware place (Glass) and GlassPanel; the SuiteWindow shell (sidebar, content, inspector) with SidebarSection and SidebarRow; ToolbarGroup palette actions; the content layer (CanvasSurface, SurfaceCard, EmptyStateView, ViewerStatusBar); the editor shell after the Ripple editor (EditorShell, EditorTopBar and its bar items, the docked ToolbarGroup rail, CanvasViewport with its Ruler, checkerboard and CanvasMarks, SegmentedTabs and the ColorWell hex row); pro inspector parts (InspectorHeader, InspectorRows, ScrubField and NumericInput number entry); the Studio easing parts (CurveEditor, StudioScrubRow, ChoiceChips); ThumbnailGrid with its selection math; and TimelineStrip with its frame mapping, shared by Flare and Halo.

containers.name: FlareApp
containers.description: The Flare app (2D animation): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/FlareApp, built from SuiteUI. Reads FlareModel and calls its methods; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule).

components.name: FlareApp sources
components.description: The Flare app (2D animation): the SwiftUI App scene, its menu bar (FlareCommands) and views in Sources/FlareApp, including the easing inspector on the live FlareWorkspace, built from SuiteUI.

containers.name: FlareModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Flare's window. FlareWorkspace: the open FlareCore document, selected scene and drawing tool. Foundation only, value types.

components.name: FlareModel sources
components.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Flare's window: FlareWorkspace holds the open FlareCore document, the selected scene and the drawing tool; EasingEditing is the easing editor's contract, which FlareWorkspace conforms to over FlareCore's SetKeyframeEasing, with FakeEasingEditing as its in-memory stand-in for UI work.

containers.name: DesignApp
containers.description: The Design app (vector and UI design): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/DesignApp, built from SuiteUI. Reads DesignModel and calls its methods; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule).

components.name: DesignApp sources
components.description: The Design app (vector and UI design): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/DesignApp, built from SuiteUI: the window, the Page menu, File > New File, and sidebar items for pages and Layers rows.

containers.name: DesignModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Design's window: pages, the node tree on each page and its Layers rows, the selected page and tool. Foundation only, value types.

components.name: DesignModel sources
components.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Design's window: DesignWorkspace (pages, selected page, tool) and DesignNode, the node tree on a page and the flattened rows the Layers sidebar draws.

containers.name: PhotoApp
containers.description: The Photo app (raster editing): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/PhotoApp, built from SuiteUI. Reads PhotoModel and calls its methods; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule).

components.name: PhotoApp sources
components.description: The Photo app (raster editing): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/PhotoApp, built from SuiteUI's EditorShell: the window and its intents, the top bar, tool rail and canvas, the Adjust | Layers panel (tool options, adjustment sections with the Levels gamma field, the layer list), the export and image size sheets, the File, Edit, Select, Image, Layer and View menus, the coalescing canvas renderer, the pen pressure read from AppKit mouse events for brush drags, and the ImageIO codec behind PhotoModel's PhotoImageCodec.

containers.name: PhotoModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Photo's window: the canvas as a CoreRaster PixelBuffer, its layer stack, selected layer and tool, adjustment settings, and inspector and Layer menu state. Foundation only, value types.

components.name: PhotoModel sources
components.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Photo's window: PhotoWorkspace (the open image's size and name, the layer stack with each layer's offset and its pixels as copy-on-write CoreRaster tiles (TiledPixels), so an edit copies only the tiles it touches, the selected layer, tool and tool options, the marquee selection and pending crop), the tools' drags (brush and eraser dabs, marquee, crop, move), selection edits and crop, Image Size and Rotate, the undo history (the tiles an edit changed, layer lists and whole stacks), the tile-parallel renderer with damage tracking and the adjustments it applies (exposure, levels, hue/saturation, blur), opening and exporting through the PhotoImageCodec protocol, the adjustment settings and logarithmic gamma track, what the inspector shows, and when each Layer menu item can run.

containers.name: LibraryApp
containers.description: The Library app (photo catalog): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/LibraryApp, built from SuiteUI. Reads LibraryModel and calls its methods; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule).

components.name: LibraryApp sources
components.description: The Library app (photo catalog): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/LibraryApp, built from SuiteUI: the window with its thumbnail grid, and the File > Load Sample Photos, View > Sort By and thumbnail size commands.

containers.name: LibraryModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Library's window: the catalog's photos, sidebar collections with counts, the selected collection and sort order, and seeded sample photos. Foundation only, value types.

components.name: LibraryModel sources
components.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Library's window: LibraryCatalog (photos, collections with counts, the selected collection, sort order), PhotoItem with its sort orders, and 60 seeded sample photos.

containers.name: HaloApp
containers.description: The Halo app (motion graphics): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/HaloApp, built from SuiteUI. Reads HaloModel and calls its methods; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule).

components.name: HaloApp sources
components.description: The Halo app (motion graphics): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/HaloApp, built from SuiteUI: the window, the Layer and Composition menus, the selected composition's layer list, the New Composition sheet, and the alert for a refused rename.

containers.name: HaloModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Halo's window: the project's compositions and their layers, the selected composition, New Composition settings, and refused renames. Foundation only, value types.

components.name: HaloModel sources
components.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Halo's window: HaloProject (compositions, the selected one, unique names), HaloLayer, the New Composition draft and its validated settings, and RefusedRename, which keeps a refused composition rename for the alert.

systems.name: creative-core
systems.description: The pure-Swift engines the Models call (github.com/qbtrix/creative-core), tracked on its main branch until it tags releases.

containers.name: FlareCore library
containers.description: Animation document model, commands with undo, timeline, file format and export.

containers.name: CoreRaster library
containers.description: Pixel buffers, compositing and image operations.
